rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Morok"We have found Fregga's Healing Rune, and now have cause to use it... Find the sacred ceremonial grounds where my boy Gymner can be brought back from his torpor. There, the ancestral rune will give me back what I have lost!"

Loremaster"The sacred teachings of Fregga's Sacred Rune prohibits this! I have told you my opinion, King Morok... Dead warriors can be brought to life for battle, but not because he is favored by the King! The rune is meant to protect the Clans!"
King's Guard"King Morok has spoken! You claim to know better than Morok, the man who led us to battle during the first great wars! He is our leader!"
Loremaster"Yes... He is... Let us do the deed.  Gather your Dwarves..."

Lizard Man 
"Thisss land is oursss now, little Dwarf... How do you exssspect to battle usss!"

Loremaster 
"The ancient ceremonial grounds have been desecrated by these beasts!  Half-eaten corpses, the stench of death... Horrible!"

Axethrower 
"Look sire, we have opened the gate..."

Loremaster 
"We must clear the altar of this filth for the ceremony... And now, place young Gymner upon it. Novice Sevendusk! Fregga's Healing Rune must be placed here..."

Loremaster 
"Something is happening! Gymner stirs uneasily..."
Loremaster"Ooh! This is not the Kings son! He is a - misshapen... thing! It's horrible! Oh! He is trying to speak!"

Morok 
"Gymner? No, not my son! Half person, half corpse... I did this to him?! No not me: it was the runes - the runes have betrayed us!"

Loremaster"The runes! Morok, do not talk nonsense! We know that the troubles of the realm burdens you, and now your son... But really, the war on the Empire and the misuse of the runes are folly! You are not fit to rule!"
Yataa'Halli"Oh no! He has gone into a frenzy! Is there no way to contain his rage? Is it really kill or be killed?! Oh Father, what have you done?!"

Man at Arms 
"We have protected this keep for Squire Grandier for a long while and he paid us well... We are willing to fight with your forces.  We know the surrounding lands very well."

Master Thug 
"We have friends everywhere, beware!"

Lizard Man 
"What do you want here? No matter, you will not lassst long in these landsss... Our alliesss will fall upon you with no delay."

Lizard Man 
"You can take our citiesss, but we are much ssstronger than you imagine..."

Goblin 
"You killed my masters, but I not be your slave!"

Orc 
"I tell all of my people to hunt you down!"

Barbarian 
"If most of us had not gone off to conquer Sumerec you wouldn't have had a chance of beating us."

Barbarian 
"ACK! We have been beaten by the short people to the North! The shame!"

Dwarf 
"We found this key on the Lizardman's corpse... We can enter now, Milord. The gate has been opened. Let us proceed..."
Loremaster"What do we do? Oh, Wotan guide us! Shall we leave him here to be killed by the cursed Goblins, or shall we end his wretched half-life?"

Valkyrie"Let me take him! The runes power has diminished and cannot bring him back completely. Not any longer... Not since the Clans have neglected the runes. Take the rune, here! The next time you use it, be just!"

King's Guard 
"Let us not waste time in this forsaken place! Haste! Haste! back to the capital to pay our regrets..."
Return to the capital with the healing rune in your posession.

Lizardman 
"Ha Ha Ha!!! You are brave indeed to have made it thisss far, but turn back while you can... there isss no way you can get through our defencesss, little onesss!"

King's Guard 
"Milord! I see ahead an abomination... It is the undead! Mortis walks again!"

Engineer 
"Yes, but nobody has discovered whom she stalks this time... It is a mystery!"
Morok"It is the Empire that we must fight!!! We have all been fools! Fools! Fooled by the Empire's heir... Uther, its sweet tasting poison -bah!"

Loremaster"What?! Why this change, Morok? The Clans cannot declare war because our leader merely distrusts a nation's heir...without reason. They have shown that they wish to ally with us! Mortis and Bethrezen lead armies against us both!"

Morok"Listen! The boy is not what he seems! He seeks power for himself only... Some of the things he said to me did not ring true. Furthermore, he asked many questions about our affairs that a strategic ally has no business knowing!"

Morok"He wished to help us in our quest for Wotan's Runes - in return for our recent aid of the Empire. I detected something... in the way he broached the subject... I am a suspicious old warrior; but battle has taught me to pick well whom I do trust!"

Morok"I banished Uther from this kingdom! If his troops are seen on our land, I order them to be destroyed! I am convinced that the Empire is plotting against us... It is better to be the aggressor in these situations!  Henceforth, we are at war!"

Engineer"Morok is meeting with Demosthene's son, Uther... Our two nations may forge a permanent alliance! We have always aided each other in troubled times; but it is possible that we shall now have even closer relations!"
Yataa'Halli"How are we to overcome this! My Father dead and disgraced... The loremaster Sevendusk gone too... I see no hope for the Clans!"

Novice 
"This valley is filled with Lizard-men! I can hear them hissing and spitting in their anger... these reptiles slither easily over the top of the stone wall! Must we pass this way?"

Morok
